en: Color photograph of a Baroque palace-like building with elaborate stone façades, statues, and a high mansard roof. A broad double staircase leads from the central entrance down toward a reflecting pond or small lake in the foreground, where many white swans and ducks are swimming. People are visible walking along the water's edge, and there is greenery and a smaller yellow building to the left. The image fills the card; no printed caption or other visible text appears on the front.
